response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), b AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS base FROM s) SELECT s.mix AS ordertypedist, s.cnt AS distinct_transactions, s.share AS share, s.share - b.base AS above_baseline FROM s, b WHERE s.share > b.base
